description: This file is a test script for assessing the functionality and robustness of 'git fsck', a Git command used to verify the integrity of objects in a Git repository. It contains numerous test cases that simulate repository corruption, missing objects, malformed headers, and other fault scenarios to ensure 'git fsck' behaves correctly under various conditions.

methods.name: sha1_file
methods.description: Calculates the file path in the objects directory for a given SHA1 hash.

methods.name: remove_object
methods.description: Deletes an object from the objects directory based on its SHA1 hash.

methods.name: corrupt_index_checksum
methods.description: Performs a manual corruption of the index file checksum to test fsck's detection capabilities.

methods.name: create_repo_missing
methods.description: Sets up repositories with deliberately missing objects to test fsck's detection of inconsistencies.
